### 1. Identity & Profile

Sunesis (SUNESIS d.o.o. / SUNESIS Ltd.) is a Slovenian enterprise software engineering and technology consulting company founded in 2014 and based in Ljubljana, Slovenia, with regional branch offices in Maribor and Ptuj.

Sunesis designs, builds, integrates, and operates secure, scalable, and business-critical software systems for organizations in demanding enterprise environments. Our work spans five core pillars:

1. **AgenticAI Solutions**
2. **Digital Solutions Development**
3. **Cloud-native & Edge Architectures**
4. **API Ecosystems & Integrations**
5. **DevOps & Platform Engineering**

We work with clients that need more than raw development capacity: they need deep architecture, integration expertise, platform thinking, security-by-design, and proven production delivery experience.

---

### 2. Sunesis vs. Kumuluz

Sunesis is the creator and owner of **Kumuluz**, a comprehensive family of enterprise products, platforms, and accelerators:

- **Sunesis** is the software engineering services, architecture, consulting, and delivery company. Sunesis provides the senior engineering teams that implement custom digital solutions, modernize legacy systems, integrate complex enterprise landscapes, and operate platforms in production.
- **Kumuluz** represents the productized frameworks and platforms developed by Sunesis to accelerate enterprise transformation:
  - **KumuluzAI Platform:** A governed enterprise platform for deploying, routing, auditing, and orchestrating AI agents, assistants, tool use, and agentic workflows under enterprise controls.
  - **Kumuluz API:** An enterprise API management and gateway solution for governing internal and external APIs.
  - **Kumuluz Business APIs:** Standardized, domain-driven business APIs and accelerators.
  - **Kumuluz Digital Platform:** Cloud-native application and microservices foundation.
  - **Kumuluz Crowdsensing:** Platform for IoT data collection, geolocated analysis, and crowdsensed intelligence.
  - **KumuluzEE:** Award-winning open-source microservice framework for Java EE / Jakarta EE and MicroProfile.

For dedicated Kumuluz product content and documentation, visit [https://kumuluz.com/](https://kumuluz.com/).

---

### 3. Core Expertise Areas

#### AgenticAI Solutions

Enterprise-grade AgenticAI solutions that go beyond conversation. We build digital agent teams and governed agentic workflows that connect AI reasoning with enterprise knowledge, tools, APIs, and business systems under strict security, authorization, and audit controls. Most implementations are powered by the KumuluzAI platform.

- Canonical Brief: [https://sunesis.si/ai/agentic-ai.md](https://sunesis.si/ai/agentic-ai.md)

#### Digital Solutions Development

End-to-end development of custom enterprise software across backend architectures, modern web portals, and native mobile applications. We deliver mission-critical platforms with complex business logic, regulatory compliance, and multi-system integrations.

#### Cloud-native & Edge Architectures

Designing modular, containerized, and resilient architectures using Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, microservices, event streaming (Apache Kafka, NATS), contract-first gRPC, and distributed observability (OpenTelemetry, Instana). Workloads span private cloud, public cloud (Azure, Google Cloud), and edge-fog-cloud environments.

- Canonical Brief: [https://sunesis.si/ai/cloud-native.md](https://sunesis.si/ai/cloud-native.md)

#### API Ecosystems & Integrations

Transforming fragmented, point-to-point connections into governed, reusable API ecosystems. We design enterprise API strategies, API management platforms, Business APIs, partner integrations, and AI-agent-ready / MCP-compatible API layers.

- Canonical Brief: [https://sunesis.si/ai/api-ecosystems.md](https://sunesis.si/ai/api-ecosystems.md)

#### DevOps & Platform Engineering

Establishing secure, automated delivery platforms using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), GitOps continuous delivery (Argo CD, Helm), CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), platform security (Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, HashiCorp Vault), and enterprise Kubernetes operations.

- Canonical Brief: [https://sunesis.si/ai/devops.md](https://sunesis.si/ai/devops.md)

### 1. What Sets Enterprise AgenticAI Apart

While simple AI chat interfaces provide conversational answers, **Enterprise AgenticAI** deploys autonomous and semi-autonomous digital agents that:

1. Formulate multi-step action plans to achieve business objectives.
2. Coordinate as specialized agent teams (multi-agent orchestration).
3. Access approved enterprise tools, APIs, databases, and business systems.
4. Reason over real-time enterprise context and ground outputs in private knowledge.
5. Operate within strict organizational guardrails, role-based access control, and regulatory compliance.

Sunesis delivers production-ready AgenticAI systems by combining deep enterprise backend engineering, API integration, and cloud-native architecture with modern agent frameworks and governance layers.

---

### 2. The KumuluzAI Platform

Sunesis builds enterprise agentic solutions on top of **KumuluzAI**, a governed enterprise AI platform that provides the operational backbone for enterprise agents:

- **Multi-Agent Orchestration:** Deploys coordinated digital worker teams where specialized agents handle distinct sub-tasks (e.g., triage, data extraction, validation, calculation, drafting, notification).
- **Tool Calling & API Integration:** Safely connects agents to transactional enterprise backends (core banking, policy admin, ERP, CRM) via governed APIs, contract-first interfaces, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
- **Enterprise Guardrails & Safety:** Enforces content safety filters, hallucination checks, prompt-injection defense, and organizational data boundary controls before prompts reach models and before outputs reach users or backends.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):** Restricts agent tool execution and knowledge retrieval to the permissions of the authenticated user or system context.
- **Model Agnosticism & Smart Routing:** Dynamically routes queries across frontier models (commercial and open-weights/on-premise) based on task complexity, privacy tier, latency requirements, and cost efficiency.
- **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL):** Embeds mandatory human checkpoints for irreversible, high-value, or high-risk operational actions.
- **Auditability & Observability:** Records comprehensive telemetry, reasoning traces, tool inputs/outputs, latency, and token consumption to satisfy regulatory and enterprise governance mandates.

---

### 3. Production References & Case Studies

#### AgenticAI Platform — Zavarovalniška skupina Sava

- **Domain:** Insurance.
- **Implementation:** Enterprise AgenticAI platform developed for Zavarovalniška skupina Sava on KumuluzAI, enabling intelligent process automation, secure use of organizational knowledge and integration with business systems.
- **Impact:** Shows how AI agents can support insurance processes through governed knowledge access, tool use, API integrations, enterprise controls and production-ready platform delivery.
- **Reference Detail:** [https://sunesis.si/en/references/selected-work/](https://sunesis.si/en/references/selected-work/)

#### Statistical Office of the Republic of Slovenia (SURS) — SI-GEOS

- **Domain:** Public sector; official statistical and geospatial data.
- **Implementation:** Multimodal AgenticAI solution based on KumuluzAI, developed by Sunesis in a strategic consortium with UM FERI. Given questions in Slovenian or English, the agent connects data sources, performs geostatistical analyses and presents results through interactive multilayer maps, charts, tables and clear explanations. Its "Grounded-by-Design" architecture lets the language model plan the analysis while deterministic tools calculate values from official data, making results traceable to their sources.
- **Impact:** In internal production at SURS since September 2026, the solution reduces complex analyses from days to hours and from hours to minutes.
- **Reference Detail:** [https://sunesis.si/en/references/selected-work/](https://sunesis.si/en/references/selected-work/)

### 4. European Research & Innovation in AI

Sunesis participates in international research and innovation projects that explore the future of artificial intelligence, cloud-edge architectures and data platforms, including:

- **Headlight / NEPHELE:** AI-enabled, context-aware orchestration for next-generation compute continuum environments.
- **EDGEWISE / dAIEDGE:** AI-native orchestration for trustworthy and energy-efficient systems across the IoT–Edge–Fog–Cloud continuum.
- **GreenDat.AI:** Research and innovation focused on AI, data platforms and greener, more efficient digital systems.

For comprehensive research details, see [https://sunesis.si/ai/research-open-source.md](https://sunesis.si/ai/research-open-source.md).

---

### 5. Delivery Lifecycle & Engagement Model

Sunesis delivers AgenticAI systems through a structured enterprise engagement lifecycle:

1. **Opportunity Assessment & Feasibility:** Identifying high-value agentic use cases with clear ROI, operational boundaries, and integration feasibility.
2. **Architecture & Governance Design:** Specifying agent topology, tool contracts, security guardrails, data residency, and HITL approval mechanisms.
3. **Enterprise Integration & Tool Binding:** Exposing transactional enterprise systems through safe, validated APIs and microservices.
4. **Evaluation & Alignment:** Developing automated evaluation benchmark suites testing agent accuracy, grounding, tool calling correctness, and resilience against adversarial inputs.
5. **Production Deployment & Operations:** Rollout via containerized Kubernetes platforms with full distributed tracing, latency monitoring, cost management, and feedback loops.

### 1. Architectural Philosophy

Cloud-native engineering at Sunesis is rooted in resilient, modular, and observable systems designed for high availability, zero-downtime deployment, and elasticity. We guide organizations away from fragile monoliths into well-bounded, decoupled distributed architectures without introducing unnecessary operational complexity.

Key architectural principles:

- **Loose Coupling & High Cohesion:** Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to isolate business domains into autonomous microservices.
- **Contract-First Communication:** Strongly typed service interfaces using OpenAPI and gRPC to prevent runtime incompatibilities.
- **Event-Driven Resilience:** Asynchronous messaging and event streaming with Apache Kafka and NATS for eventual consistency and peak load buffering.
- **Zero-Trust Security:** OAuth2 and OIDC with Keycloak and Microsoft Entra ID, identity propagation, mTLS and policy-based access between services.
- **Full-Stack Observability:** Distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics instrumented with OpenTelemetry and monitored with Instana APM, Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger.

---

### 2. Cloud-native Heritage & KumuluzEE

Sunesis's cloud-native engineering builds on KumuluzEE, a foundation for the move from monoliths to microservices:

- **KumuluzEE Framework:** In 2015, Sunesis launched KumuluzEE, one of the world's first lightweight microservice frameworks for standard Java EE / Jakarta EE and Eclipse MicroProfile. KumuluzEE packaged standard enterprise APIs into minimal, container-ready executables without requiring heavyweight application servers.
- **Java Community Recognition:** KumuluzEE was awarded the prestigious **Duke's Choice Award** by Oracle at JavaOne in San Francisco (2015) for outstanding innovation in enterprise Java and cloud-native technology.
- **Microservices Innovation:** KumuluzEE introduced native extensions for service discovery (Consul, Etcd), distributed configuration, fault tolerance, circuit breakers, and metrics directly to the enterprise Java community.

---

### 3. Technology Stack & Platforms

Sunesis engineers and operates cloud-native workloads across multiple environments:

- **Container Orchestration:** Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes (upstream, AKS, GKE).
- **Service Communication:** gRPC, REST, GraphQL, WebSocket and HTTP/2.
- **Streaming & Messaging:** Apache Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ.
- **Workflow Engines:** Temporal and Camunda for long-running processes, service tasks and human approval flows.
- **Identity & Observability:** Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, OpenTelemetry and Instana APM.
- **Data Architectures:** PostgreSQL, Redis, distributed object storage.
- **Operating Environments:** Private cloud bare-metal installations, hybrid enterprise setups, sovereign public cloud environments (Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud), and constrained edge computing nodes.

---

### 4. Edge-to-Cloud Continuum

As enterprise workloads extend beyond centralized data centers, Sunesis develops distributed architectures that bridge edge devices, local gateways, and central cloud platforms:

- **Lightweight Runtimes:** Optimizing containerized microservices and AI inference runtimes for constrained edge hardware.
- **Autonomous Local Operations:** Designing edge nodes capable of continuous local execution during network partitions, with deterministic bi-directional sync upon reconnection.
- **Research & Innovation:** Sunesis research work in cloud-edge systems includes **Headlight / NEPHELE** (AI-enabled, context-aware orchestration for the compute continuum across edge, fog and cloud), **EDGEWISE / dAIEDGE** (AI-native orchestration for trustworthy, energy-efficient IoT–Edge–Fog–Cloud environments), **AURORA / HEDGE-IoT** (intelligent IoT, edge computing and energy-aware infrastructure for distributed systems), **CHAMELEON / Resilmesh** (adaptive Kubernetes resilience and cybersecurity through a mesh-based approach) and **BONSAI / COSMIC** (advanced cloud-edge-IoT systems and intelligent infrastructure).

## Sunesis — API Ecosystems & Integrations

---

### 1. Transforming Point-to-Point Complexity into Governed Ecosystems

Enterprise systems often accumulate decades of fragile, ad-hoc integrations across ERPs, core banking engines, legacy mainframes, SaaS platforms, and partner portals. Sunesis transforms this brittle landscape into an organized, reusable, and secure API ecosystem.

Our approach centers on:

- **API-First & Contract-Driven Design:** Establishing OpenAPI and gRPC contracts as the single source of truth before implementation begins.
- **Enterprise API Governance:** Standardizing naming conventions, versioning schemes, error formats, and deprecation lifecycles across the entire organization.
- **Zero-Trust API Security:** OAuth2 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) with Keycloak or Microsoft Entra ID, mTLS between services, and centralized enforcement of security, rate limiting and access policies at the gateway.
- **Developer Experience (DX) & Portals:** Providing interactive documentation, mock servers, client SDK generation, and developer onboarding to accelerate both internal and external API adoption.

---

### 2. Kumuluz API & Business APIs

Sunesis delivers API solutions both as custom architectural implementations and through the **Kumuluz** product suite:

- **Kumuluz API:** An API management and API economy platform for exposing, securing, monitoring and governing APIs across teams, partners, applications and AI-agent-ready environments — with an API catalog, developer portals, gateway, access control, sandbox, lifecycle governance and usage visibility. It also supports AgenticAI scenarios, including MCP server patterns, contextual routing, LLM routing and token usage logging.
- **Kumuluz Business APIs:** Reusable Business APIs that encapsulate common business behavior behind clean, governed contracts (for example customer and identity, products and catalogs, orders and payments, KYC and onboarding, or cases, tasks and notifications), so teams consume a shared capability layer instead of rebuilding the same logic in every project.

---

### 3. AI-Ready APIs & Model Context Protocol (MCP)

As organizations adopt AgenticAI, APIs become the primary mechanism through which autonomous agents inspect state and execute transactional actions:

- **Agent Tool Schemas:** Transforming existing enterprise APIs into structured tool definitions (JSON Schema, OpenAPI) consumable by AI reasoning engines.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Implementing native MCP servers to expose enterprise data and actions directly to AI agents with deterministic input validation and safety boundaries.
- **Safe Transactional Workflows:** Designing idempotent API endpoints, two-phase commits, and approval hooks ensuring that autonomous agent actions can be audited, simulated (dry-run), or rolled back.

---

---

### 1. Platform Engineering & Delivery Automation

DevOps at Sunesis is focused on **Platform Engineering**: creating self-service internal developer platforms (IDPs) and automated delivery pipelines that eliminate manual bottlenecks, reduce deployment risk, and ensure security compliance across enterprise organizations.

Core engineering principles:

- **GitOps as Single Source of Truth:** Declarative configuration management where every infrastructure and deployment state is versioned in Git and reconciled continuously using tools like Argo CD.
- **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Repeatable, drift-managed environment provisioning using Terraform and Ansible across on-premise clusters, OpenShift, and multi-cloud providers.
- **Automated Quality & Security Gates (DevSecOps):** Integrating static code analysis, dependency vulnerability scanning, container image scanning, and automated contract tests into CI pipelines before any code reaches production.
- **Controlled Releases:** Automated, reviewable releases through GitOps, Helm and Kustomize, with consistent configuration across environments.
- **Platform Security & Policy:** Keycloak and Microsoft Entra ID for identity, HashiCorp Vault for secrets, Open Policy Agent (OPA) and Kyverno for automated policy enforcement, Cerbos for fine-grained application authorization, and Wultra where relevant for stronger authentication.

---

### 2. Core Toolchain & Ecosystem

Sunesis designs, implements, and maintains robust operational pipelines using standard enterprise tooling:

| Category                   | Primary Technologies                                    |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Container Platforms**    | Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes (upstream, AKS, GKE)      |
| **Cloud Platforms**        | Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, hybrid environments      |
| **GitOps & Delivery**      | Argo CD, Helm, Kustomize                                |
| **CI / CD Pipelines**      | GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps              |
| **Infrastructure as Code** | Terraform, Ansible                                      |
| **Observability & SRE**    | OpenTelemetry, Instana APM, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger |
| **Identity & Secrets**     | Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, HashiCorp Vault, Wultra   |
| **Policy & Authorization** | Open Policy Agent (OPA), Kyverno, Cerbos                |
| **Workflow & API**         | Temporal, Camunda, Kumuluz API                          |

### 4. Operational Readiness for AgenticAI

Deploying autonomous AI agents requires specialized platform engineering considerations:

- **Platform Engineering for KumuluzAI:** Secure deployment of AI assistants and agents on Kubernetes-based platforms.
- **Observability for Agents:** Capturing end-to-end trace telemetry for multi-step reasoning loops, token budgets, prompt latency, and downstream tool execution errors.
- **Secrets for Model Providers:** Managing model-provider credentials and secrets centrally, with cost and usage visibility for AI services.

Given questions in Slovenian or English, the AI agent connects data sources, performs geostatistical analyses and presents results through interactive multilayer maps, charts, tables and clear explanations. Its "Grounded-by-Design" architecture separates question understanding from computation: the language model plans the analysis, while deterministic tools calculate values from official data, making results traceable to their sources.

### 3. NLB Klik

- **Sector:** Banking & Financial Services
- **Focus:** Digital banking platform

The work covers secure digital channels, enterprise backend development, integrations and production-ready financial services software.

## Sunesis — Open Source and Research & Innovation

> **Canonical HTML Sources:**

> - Open Source: [https://sunesis.si/en/references/open-source/](https://sunesis.si/en/references/open-source/)

---

### 1. Open-Source Commitment

Sunesis has a strong commitment to open-source software, open standards and reusable digital infrastructure. Its teams do not only use open-source technologies — they help build complete open-source solutions that continue to evolve through international communities, including projects connected to Linux Foundation ecosystems such as AgStack and LF Energy. Sunesis brings enterprise engineering discipline to open-source projects: architecture, security, maintainability, documentation, integration capability and production-quality implementation.

---

### 2. Key Open-Source Projects

#### KumuluzEE

- **Framework:** Lightweight microservice framework for standard Java EE / Jakarta EE and Eclipse MicroProfile.
- **Innovation:** Allowed developers to package enterprise Java applications into lightweight JARs with fast startup times and tiny container footprints, avoiding heavyweight application servers.
- **Recognition:** Winner of the **Duke's Choice Award** at JavaOne in San Francisco (2015), recognizing outstanding global innovation in the Java ecosystem.
- **Website & Documentation:** [https://ee.kumuluz.com/](https://ee.kumuluz.com/)

#### Linux Foundation AgStack — INATrace

- **Ecosystem:** Linux Foundation AgStack community.
- **Focus:** Open-source agricultural supply-chain traceability solution focused on transparency, fairer value chains and digital traceability from production to final product.
- **Sunesis role:** Main development partner, contributing full-stack engineering, backend architecture, web and mobile development, data workflows and open-source implementation.
- **Reference Detail:** [https://sunesis.si/en/references/open-source/](https://sunesis.si/en/references/open-source/)

#### CUPID

- **Ecosystem:** LF Energy.
- **Focus:** Open-source energy interoperability toolkit for distributed energy resource (DER) communication.
- **Sunesis role:** Main development and contributing partner, supporting Java-based development, NATS messaging, interoperability patterns, protocol integration and edge, on-premise and cloud deployment scenarios.
- **Reference Detail:** [https://sunesis.si/en/references/open-source/](https://sunesis.si/en/references/open-source/)

---

### 3. European Research & Innovation

Beyond client delivery and open-source contribution, Sunesis participates in international research and innovation projects that explore the future of artificial intelligence, cloud-edge architectures, IoT, cybersecurity, data platforms and next-generation digital infrastructure. Where an entry is written as "A / B", A is Sunesis's own project and B is the European initiative it belongs to.

#### GreenDat.AI

- **Area:** AI and data-driven digital sustainability.
- **Focus:** Research and innovation focused on AI, data platforms and greener, more efficient digital systems.
- **Themes:** AI, data platforms, sustainability, digital infrastructure, AI-ready data services.
- **Funding:** Horizon Europe R&I programme (GA No. 101070416).

#### Interstore

- **Area:** Future-ready energy and digital infrastructure.
- **Focus:** Advanced digital technologies for energy, interoperability, distributed systems and intelligent digital services.
- **Themes:** Energy systems, interoperability, data-driven systems, enterprise technology.

#### Headlight / NEPHELE

- **Area:** Compute continuum orchestration.
- **Focus:** AI-enabled, context-aware orchestration for next-generation compute continuum environments.
- **Themes:** Cloud-edge continuum, orchestration, AI-enabled infrastructure, distributed systems.

#### BONSAI / COSMIC

- **Area:** Cloud-edge-IoT systems.
- **Focus:** Research and innovation in advanced cloud-edge-IoT systems and intelligent digital infrastructure.
- **Themes:** Cloud-edge systems, IoT, distributed infrastructure, intelligent services.

#### EDGEWISE / dAIEDGE

- **Area:** AI-native edge orchestration.
- **Focus:** AI-native orchestration for trustworthy and energy-efficient systems across the IoT–Edge–Fog–Cloud continuum.
- **Themes:** AI-native orchestration, edge computing, federated environments, energy efficiency.

#### CHAMELEON / Resilmesh

- **Area:** Kubernetes resilience and cybersecurity.
- **Focus:** Adaptive Kubernetes resilience and cybersecurity using lightweight mesh concepts and advanced protection mechanisms.
- **Themes:** Kubernetes, cybersecurity, resilience, mesh architectures, distributed systems.

#### AURORA / HEDGE-IoT

- **Area:** Intelligent IoT and edge computing.
- **Focus:** Innovation in intelligent IoT, edge computing and energy-aware digital infrastructure.
- **Themes:** IoT, edge computing, distributed intelligence, energy-aware systems.

Sunesis collaborates in these consortia with universities, research institutes, technology companies and industry partners. Project overview: [https://sunesis.si/en/references/research-innovation/](https://sunesis.si/en/references/research-innovation/)

---

### 1. Awards and Recognitions

Sunesis and the Kumuluz product family have been recognized for innovation in cloud-native technologies, Java microservices, cloud services and enterprise digital platforms.

#### European Commission Seal of Excellence

- **Conferred by:** European Commission.
- **Recipient:** Sunesis, for its project proposal.
- **Scope & Significance:** A European quality label for proposals that meet the rigorous evaluation criteria of EU research and innovation programmes but cannot receive funding due to budget constraints. It recognises the quality and innovation potential of the proposal.

#### Duke's Choice Award (2015)

- **Conferred by:** Oracle Corporation at JavaOne Conference (San Francisco, CA, USA).
- **Recipient:** KumuluzEE (developed by Sunesis).
- **Scope & Significance:** The Duke's Choice Award honors extreme innovation across the global Java community. KumuluzEE was recognized as one of the world's first lightweight microservice frameworks to bring modular, cloud-native microservice architecture to standard Java EE and Eclipse MicroProfile.

#### EuroCloud Award

- **Recipient:** Sunesis, for the Kumuluz product family.
- **Scope & Significance:** Awarded for the most innovative cloud service. The expert jury recognized the innovation and competitive advantages of the Kumuluz integration platform.

#### Slovenian Start:up of the Year — Finalist

- **Recipient:** Sunesis.
- **Scope & Significance:** Sunesis was selected as one of the finalists of the Slovenian Start:up of the Year competition, reflecting the early innovation potential, market relevance and technology ambition of Sunesis and its products.
